name: Pivoting to new tools or features upon side-project friction
hypothesis: When encountering technical friction or setup obstacles during personal side projects, the user switches focus to researching alternative tools or exploring new features, leaving the original project unfinished.

name: External feedback and commitments driving project completion
hypothesis: When receiving external feedback or making a public commitment regarding a project, the user maintains consistent follow-through and completes or refines the deliverable.

name: Adding unplanned items to meet promotional thresholds
hypothesis: When an online shopping cart is near a discount or free-shipping threshold, the user adds unplanned items to qualify for the promotion, increasing total expenditure.
